review_notes: I reviewed all 123 lines of Mathlib/Data/Fintype/Option.lean against the repeated-proof-machinery rubric. I did not read any related source files. The only similar blocks are the `zero` and `succ` cases of `Fintype.truncRecEmptyOption`. Each proves a short card equality, applies `Trunc.bind (truncEquivOfCardEq this)`, and then calls `of_equiv`.
